prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph at night in an empty English community hall, folding chairs stacked against the wall, one fluorescent strip light overhead casting cold teal. On a long trestle table stretching away from camera sits a vast architectural model: rows and rows of tiny unpainted grey card terraced houses packed shoulder to shoulder to the far end of the table and spilling onto a second table, every one dark. In the near corner a much smaller cluster of tiny model figures, lit teal, dwarfed. A hand-lettered card propped at the front reads "303,185". Shot on cheap colour negative film with a 35mm lens, low angle, shallow depth of field, heavy grain, scuffed lino floor. Thanks.
